sql: with t as (select distinct o.market_ticker from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Jmmsell10' and o.action='buy'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from t) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc, id desc), oth as (select o.market_ticker, sum(f.quantity) q from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy<>'Jmmsell10' and o.action='buy' and o.market_ticker in (select market_ticker from t) group by 1) select p.market_ticker, p.quantity, p.realized_pnl, coalesce(oth.q,0) other_q from p left join oth on oth.market_ticker=p.market_ticker
